statutory_framework.mva_section: Section 136A, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (inserted via 2019 Amendment)
statutory_framework.legal_metrology_act: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011
statutory_framework.evidence_act_section: Section 65B, Indian Evidence Act, 1872 / Section 63, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023

mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.title: Clear Vehicle & Number Plate Photograph
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.description: Clear photographic or video evidence showing the vehicle and legible number plate at the time of violation.

mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.title: Speed Measurement & Limit Differential
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.description: Recorded speed reading alongside the officially notified speed limit for that road stretch.

mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.title: Date, Time & Exact Geographical Location
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.description: Precise timestamp down to the minute/second and GPS coordinates or distinct road milestone.

mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.title: Specific Legal Provision Citation
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.description: Specific sections of MVA 1988 and rules of CMVR 1989 explicitly referenced on the notice.

mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.title: Electronic Record Admissibility Certification
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.statutory_basis: Sec 65B IEA / Sec 63 BSA & CMVR Rule 167A(6)
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.description: Certificate attesting integrity of electronic data acquisition without digital tampering.

mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.title: Annual Legal Metrology Calibration Certificate
mandatory_evidentiary_criteria.description: Speed camera or radar speed gun must hold valid calibration certificate within 12 months.

rti_application_template.subject: Application under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 regarding Speed Camera Calibration and Certification Details
rti_application_template.standard_fee: Rs 10/- via Postal Order / Court Fee Stamp / Online RTI Portal
questions: Whether the speed enforcement device/radar/camera used to record Notice No. {challan_no} possesses a valid verification and calibration certificate issued by the Controller of Legal Metrology as required under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
Provide a certified true copy of the calibration certificate of the said camera/device in force on the date of alleged offence ({violation_date}).
Provide the permissible margin of error (tolerance percentage) certified by the manufacturer/certifying agency for the said speed monitoring device.
Provide the date of last servicing and calibration test conducted on the specific device before {violation_date}.
